description: A procedural multi-room dungeon generator for Minecraft

releases.notes: Version 1.13.2: Probably the actual final version as attempts at updating have failed and I grow tired of Minecraft, and of modding.

This may be the final version of the project; not 100% definite, but pretty likely at this point.

Too much has changed since the last release was drafted, it's been too long, I can't remember all the specific changes.  I will say that this mod has grown in too far more than I originally imagined.  While a few originally planned features (notable variable base height between rooms) were dropped early on as not likely to improve the play experience, and a few others were later considered and not pursued (multi-level dungeons, a dungeon dimension), it numerous other features I'd not originally thought of have been added (so as adaptations and others as requests or code donations).  The size, popularity, feature count, and life span of development have grown far more than I'd ever had imagined in the early days of development.

Still, all good things must come to an end.  I find myself drifting away from Minecraft, both the game and the community, as other interests and outright needs come into my life.  At the same time, changes in both the game and modding tools mean that the next update, if possible, would lead to steps back and feature stripping (including of some that were core from the beginning).  Now it's at a high point with popularity only rising, but in the spirit of the old rock-n-roll saying, "Better to burn out than fade away," I'd rather it end at its peak and be remember or revisited for what its become than continue on in diminished and diminishing form.

Its been a great time and brought a lot of learning, and simply looking at the code and remember when, and how, and in what mindset, I'd developed different parts brings back such nostalgia.  But well, we all have to let our babies go some time.
